# agentmail_inbox (Resource)

An AgentMail inbox.

~> **Replacing or destroying an inbox deletes its messages, threads and drafts.** `username`, `domain`, `pod_id` and `client_id` can't change in place, so changing any of them replaces the inbox. Plans that replace or destroy an inbox carry a warning; consider `lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true }`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "agentmail_inbox" "support" {
  username     = "support"
  display_name = "Support"

  metadata = {
    team = "support"
    tier = 2
  }

  # Replacing or destroying an inbox deletes its mail.
  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}

# An inbox on a verified domain, created paused.
resource "agentmail_inbox" "billing" {
  username = "billing"
  domain   = "example.com"
  status   = "paused"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `client_id` (String) A client-chosen ID that makes creation idempotent: creating again with the same `client_id` returns the existing inbox. AgentMail allows no `@` in it. Changing it replaces the inbox, which deletes its mail.
- `display_name` (String) The name shown with the address, as in `Display Name <username@domain>`. Removing it from the configuration leaves AgentMail's value in place.
- `domain` (String) The part of the address after the `@`: `agentmail.to`, a verified domain, or a subdomain of a verified domain that has subdomains enabled. Defaults to `agentmail.to`. Changing it replaces the inbox, which deletes its mail.
- `metadata` (Dynamic) Custom metadata: an object of up to 256 strings, numbers and booleans, which keep their types. Keys and strings are at most 256 characters. The configuration is authoritative: an apply removes keys set elsewhere. Updates send only the keys that changed. `{}` removes all metadata; removing the attribute leaves AgentMail's value in place.
- `pod_id` (String) The pod the inbox belongs to. Defaults to the organization's default pod. Changing it replaces the inbox, which deletes its mail.
- `status` (String) `active` or `paused`. A paused inbox neither sends nor receives: mail that arrives while it is paused is not delivered, then or on resume. Removing it from the configuration leaves AgentMail's value in place.
- `username` (String) The part of the address before the `@`. AgentMail generates one when unset. Changing it replaces the inbox, which deletes its mail.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the inbox was created, in RFC 3339.
- `email` (String) The inbox's email address.
- `inbox_id` (String) The inbox's ID, which is its email address. Import an inbox by it.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# An inbox is imported by its ID, which is its email address.
terraform import agentmail_inbox.support support@agentmail.to
```
